name: Publish codxjuniorai/codxjuniorai:v0.0.1 to Docker Hub
description:
Build and push the first release artifact to Docker Hub.

TARGET REPOSITORY (changed by the operator): namespace `codxjuniorai`, repository `codxjuniorai`
→ image `codxjuniorai/codxjuniorai:v0.0.1` (plus the `latest` alias).

WHAT TO RUN
Use the `dockerhub_publish` tool (NOT a docker exec: this runtime kills exec children and caps
calls at 120 s, so the tool's own long timeout is the only way a multi-stage build survives):

    dockerhub_publish(
      image_name="codxjuniorai",
      namespace="codxjuniorai",
      tags=["v0.0.1", "latest"],
      platforms="linux/amd64",
      dockerfile="codx-junior-installer/demo/Dockerfile",
      context=".",
      build_args={
        "CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_VERSION": "0.0.1",
        "CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_REF": "v0.0.1",
        "CODX_JUNIOR_BUILD_COMMIT": "1af62f8cddd9",
      },
      push=True, timeout=3600)

PRECONDITION
The api server must have been restarted after the `_vault_token()` patch in
`api/codx/junior/tools/dockerhub_tools.py`, otherwise `_token()` returns "" and the publish aborts
with "DOCKERHUB_TOKEN is required to push". The token lives in `.codx/secrets/vault.json`; it must
never be echoed, logged or committed.

ACCEPTANCE
`dockerhub_tags(repository="codxjuniorai")` lists `v0.0.1` with `linux/amd64`, and a container run
from that image answers `GET /api/health` with `ref: v0.0.1`.

FALLBACK
`git push origin v0.0.1` → .github/workflows/release.yml publishes from CI (still targets
codxjunior/codx-junior; the repository name must be aligned there first).
